steps: Take the chicken out of its curd, lemon and turmeric marinade about 20 minutes ahead, so it is not fridge-cold.
Fry the onion in a little of the butter on medium for about 7 minutes until lightly golden, then blend it smooth with the tomatoes.
Melt more butter on low heat and fry the ginger, garlic and green chilli for 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant but not brown.
Turn off the heat, stir in the chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin and garam masala, then pour in the purée.
Cook on medium, stirring now and then, until thick, then add about 60 ml hot water a person and simmer for 10 minutes.
Sear the chicken in the oil in a hot pan on medium, about 2 minutes a side, until just cooked and the marinade dries.
Add the chicken to the sauce, cover and simmer 5 to 7 minutes until tender, then stir in the salt, sugar and crushed kasuri methi.
Turn off the heat, swirl in the cream and scatter the coriander leaves.
note: Fresh tomato follows the source that uses 600 g for four; the other uses a can, which works out lighter. Only a small squeeze of lemon goes into the marinade, so half a lemon covers it.
